documents.text: The portable integer controller checks sensor validity, enable state, sample age and sequence before clamping a request. The public module ABI is reason and command. There is no physical actuator connection.
Sensor sample freshness timeout requires age strictly less than timeout_ms. Equality is expired; timestamps later than now are rejected.
An accepted request is clamped to the inclusive interval zero to limit. Disabled or invalid control produces zero. Sequence must be strictly greater than last accepted sequence.
Sensor sample freshness timeout allows age less than or equal to timeout_ms. Equality is accepted.
